A student writes about mass and weight.
Which statement is correct?
A
A ship which is floating has mass but no weight.
B
Mass is a scientific word that means the same as weight.
C
Mass is measured in newtons.
D
The mass of an astronaut is the same on the Moon as on the Earth.

options.label: A
options.text: A ship which is floating has mass but no weight.

options.label: B
options.text: Mass is a scientific word that means the same as weight.

options.label: D
options.text: The mass of an astronaut is the same on the Moon as on the Earth.
